settings.repere: Paragraphe · Skin isn’t vanity. It’s gear. We’re here
settings.text: Skin isn’t vanity. It’s gear. We’re here to help people who train stay on the mats, and come home clean.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Most of what athletes put on their skin
settings.text: Most of what athletes put on their skin works against them. Harsh antibacterial washes and cheap tea-tree bars strip the skin’s acid mantle, the thin, slightly acidic film that is your first line of defence.
GUARD and STRIKE with totara wood, lemon myrtle, bergamot, pomegranate, thyme, aloe vera and dragon's blood resin

settings.repere: Paragraphe · So we went the other way. Plant-derived
settings.text: So we went the other way. Plant-derived bioactives chosen from published research, in a formula that’s light, quick-drying and works with your skin’s barrier, not against it.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · No filler. No gimmicks. Made in Melbourn
settings.text: No filler. No gimmicks. Made in Melbourne with a specialist chemist. A routine you’ll actually keep, because it takes 30 seconds and lives in your bag.
